propositions: The query ticket digest is re-sent in full on every overlap judge call, sitting in the volatile user message where it cannot be cached, costing 16,040 input tokens over 12 calls with zero cache hits.
Hoisting the invariant query digest into the system prompt makes it part of the cacheable prefix, enabling one cache write plus N-1 cheap reads within a batch.

The measured system prefix reaches 846 tokens, below the real 1024-token cache floor for claude-sonnet-4-6, so the hoist produces zero cache reads and adds +936 input tokens (+5.8%) due to the orientation paragraph.
Precision is preserved across 12 ordered pairs: all relations, shared artifacts, and surfaces remain identical between the baseline (inline digest) and hoisted builds.

The sequential judge loop does not parallelize, so the first call warms the prefix and subsequent reads are cheap; parallelizing would require a warm-up call before fan-out to avoid turning 1 write into N premium writes.
